title: Pen Nib
description: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Tracks the number of Attacks played. Every 10th Attack receives a 2x damage multiplier. The counter displays the number of Attacks played modulo 10 (0-9). When the 10th Attack is queued, the relic visually activates and applies double damage to that specific card.
